notes.edgeMeaning: An undirected pair exists if either Wikipedia page links to the other.
notes.sampling: Uniform nonisolated person, then uniform neighbor; ties included in friend >= person.
notes.null: Fresh copy of observed simple graph for every shuffle; 10m successful swaps; connectivity unconstrained.
notes.test: Two-sided equal-tail corrected Monte Carlo test of exact person-first friend mean; minimum p=2/101.
notes.layout: Week 1 coordinates reused across models; placement is not a measurement.
